thread:
alex: quick FYI — saw a tenant where the per-model unit-econ panel shows prefetch savings > total token cost after yesterday's quota bump. looks like negative net cost in the row :confused:
rachel: ouch. which widget/time window? link?
alex: token-econ table, tenant: acme-inc, 1h window. screenshot in thread. truncated event: ```invocation_end { tenant: acme-inc, route: /v1/chat, model_variant: redwood-7b-q4, prefetch_credits: 3, billed_tokens: 120 }```
tom: that pattern usually means we credited prefetches then later reversed them but the UI only shows gross credits. are we emitting reversals?
lina: I dug in — router sometimes cancels speculative prefetch when it reroutes to a cheaper variant; we didn't consistently emit a compensating credit_reversal event. billing only sees the assign events so heatmap shows inflated savings.
rachel: two layers here: metrics and quota. metrics need net vs gross, quota needs to not let tenants spend phantom credits.
metric-bot: suggestion: emit two lightweight counters: `prefetch.assign` and `prefetch.reversal` with labels {tenant, model_family, route}. keep full `model_variant` in a sampled audit stream for debugging.
alex: +1 to keeping variant out of high-cardinality labels. product wants an explicit "Net vs Gross" toggle in the console heatmap. net = assign - reversal. gross = assign.
tom: API debate: should router call BillingService.ReverseCredit synchronously on reroute, or emit `credit_reversal` event and let billing consume? synchronous ensures immediate quota correctness but couples latency.
lina: prefer compensating async events. safer in distributed infra, idempotent consumer handles duplicates. also avoids blocking the router on billing RPCs and tail latency spikes.
rachel: agree on async. but for quota enforcement we need immediate effect. proposal: when prefetch is allocated mark it as "provisional" in Router with a short TTL; on reroute emit reversal and also decrement provisional budget locally for quick checks. final reconciliation via events.
metric-bot: metric pipeline change: map `model_variant -> model_family` at source to reduce cardinality. emit counters with `tenant, model_family, initial_route, final_route` (final_route optional). full JSON with variant_ids -> audit topic sampled 1%.
alex: UX copy: "Net prefetch savings reflect reconciled credits. Toggle to view gross (pre-reconciliation) values." add hover tooltip: "original route | final route | last reconciliation reason".
tom: I'll add the migration in the metrics shim and a small reconciler that consumes `credit_reversal` events and emits `prefetch.reversal`. schema: ```{ credit_id, tenant, model_family, amount, reversal_reason, timestamp }```
rachel: watch cardinality on `reversal_reason` — prefer a bounded enum.
lina: will prototype the toggle (2 states) and the tooltip. product wants the small sparkline for model_family delta too.
alex: thanks. can we also add a cheap alert: when gross - net > 5% of tenant burn over 5m, ping econ-ops?
metric-bot: deploy scheduled: econ-prefetch-reconcile v1 -> canary infra-b in 30m :rocket:
tom: will monitor logs and reconciler lag. pinging @eng-sre for visibility.
alex: okay will re-check heatmap tomorrow AM after canary. good work team.
